store: Hide Rack round 2 (static fan, bigger): post with 8 hinged frames laced with leather, each frame's stretched hide its own panel mesh; 8 wedge bays on a half-disc deck

frame.frames_note: static in round 2; angle_deg from the right-hand back line (Unity -x) towards the front (+z), about the post axis; frames[].bay = the bay the frame hangs over (its angle lies inside that bay's wedge); the frame's hide is NOT in HideRack.obj, see panels

panels_doc: Panel_<bay>.obj = the stretched hide of the frame over that bay, in the piece's own coordinates (same axes as HideRack.obj: origin = footprint centre on the ground, drawn at identity with the frame's material). UV: ONE neutral light hide tile (atlas u 0-95, v 0-31, R=G=B, mean ~0.88; sides use its darker v 0-2 edge band). The mod draws a bay's panel only while the bay holds something, with the material colour multiplied by that hide's mean colour (hide_mean_colour_srgb below is the table the renders used); an empty bay's frame stands bare (loose leather lacing thongs stay in HideRack.obj).
leather: one darker leather tile (atlas u 96-127, v 0-31) for the lacing loops round the bars (150, every 10-15 cm, wrap + loose tail), the hinge straps over the stiles and the wraps round the post; no iron in the hinges
space: Unity prefab space, metres, y up, +z front, origin = footprint centre on the ground (Blender export: ux=-bx, uy=bz, uz=-by).

items.note: all hides and pelts in the game files; extra_items exist but are not obtainable in vanilla today

unit_semantics: 64 units = 8 bays x 8 units, one stack per unit, listed bay by bay in fill order (bay key = group: one hide kind per bay). Each copy: the item's model in the mod's item space, scaled uniformly so its longest bounds side is fit_longest_m, rotated by quat_xyzw about its bounds centre, bounds centre at unit.position + offset. unit.box bottom = the lowest corner of any copy's rotated bounds (the never-below-the-floor lift leaves the settled pile alone). The poses are those of the bay's own item (bays[].item).
hide_layouts_doc: Every hide's own physics-settled pile in BAY-LOCAL space, for showing any hide in any bay: stacks[k] = the copies of the k-th stack of that hide in a bay. World (prefab) pose: bounds centre = bays[b].floor_centre + bays[b].rot * offset, rotation = bays[b].rot * rot_quat_xyzw, uniform scale so the longest bounds side is fit_longest_m (= scale x the item's true size). Settled once in the common wedge cavity and checked against the frame in all 8 bays.
physics: Blender rigid body (Bullet): convex hulls, friction 0.8, restitution 0, damping 0.5/0.95, margin 1.5 mm, substeps 20, iterations 40; copy by copy (stacks 2,1,2,1,2,1,2,1), earlier copies frozen; a copy is dropped again when it ends outside the wedge cavity (divider faces + 9 mm, rim, post foot, under deck + 0.58 m) or more than 5 mm from a support.
